rows.note: A reveal whose target is hidden by the project/kind/host/sleeping filters asks first; confirming adjusts only the blocking filters and reveals, canceling leaves them intact. Header reveals switch grouping in the row-key path.
The diff-notes Send button opens the target mode; the mode's worktree bypasses host/device/menu filters and its branch is forced visible through the same projection.
Opening the target mode expands the target project and its project group, so the picker and the forced row are never hidden by collapse.

Failed scans reject with a JSON failureKind/message/fixCommand payload; the indicator classifies it, shows a per-kind tooltip, offers Copy command only when the payload carries one, plus retry and diagnostics.
